parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (1.0645); it performed worse than my current best (1.0436). It seems the combination of DEPTH=6 and the current LR/warmup was already near optimal, and my recent change (unspecified in log, but likely an attempted LR increase) caused instability. Reverting to 1.0436. Next, I will try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.10 as planned.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.10 to see if the increased capacity of DEPTH=6 can handle a higher learning rate and drive val_bpb lower.
